'''Raymond Brunson Huey''' (born 14 September 1944) is a [[biologist]] specializing in [[evolutionary physiology]].  He has taught at the [[University of Washington]] (UW), and he earned his [[Ph.D.]] in biology at [[Harvard University]] under E. E. Williams.  He has recently been the chair of the university's biology department,<ref name=UWbio>{{cite web
 |accessdate  = March 18, 2009
 |url         = http://www.biology.washington.edu/index.html?navID=42&parecID=1151
 |title       = Profile: Raymond B. Huey, Professor and Chair
 |publisher   = Department of Biology, University of Washington
 |url-status     = dead
 |archiveurl  = https://web.archive.org/web/20090319103431/http://www.biology.washington.edu/index.html?navID=42&parecID=1151
 |archivedate = March 19, 2009
}}</ref> but a retirement celebration was held on 4 Oct. 2013 in Seattle.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://hueyfest.wordpress.com/hueyblog/|title=HueyFest}}</ref>

==Education==
After attending [[Deep Springs College]], Huey earned his [[Bachelor's Degree|A.B.]] with honors in Zoology in 1966 from the [[University of California, Berkeley]].  In 1966, he earned his [[Master of Arts|M.A.]] in  Zoology from the [[University of Texas at Austin]], working with [[Eric R. Pianka]].  He then earned his [[Ph.D.]] from Harvard in 1975.<ref name=UWbio/>

==Awards==
In 1991, he received the [https://herpetologistsleague.org/awards/distinguished-herpetologists-lecture-series/ Distinguished Herpetologist Award] from [https://herpetologistsleague.org/ the Herpetologists League], and in 1998, he was awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] in Organismic Biology & Ecology.<ref name=Guggenheim>{{cite web
 |accessdate  = March 18, 2009
 |url         = http://www.gf.org/fellows/all?index=h&page=19
 |title       = All Fellows
 |publisher   = The John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation
 |url-status     = dead
 |archiveurl  = https://web.archive.org/web/20110603234454/http://www.gf.org/fellows/all?index=h&page=19
 |archivedate = June 3, 2011
}}</ref> He was elected a Fellow of the [[Ecological Society of America]] in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-02-06 |title=Ecological Society of America announces 2017 Fellows |url=https://esa.org/blog/2017/02/06/ecological-society-of-america-announces-2017-fellows/ |access-date=2025-08-12 |website=Ecological Society of America}}</ref> In 2024, Huey was elected a member of the [[National Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=30 April 2024 |title=National Academy of Sciences Elects Members and International Members |url=https://www.nasonline.org/news-and-multimedia/news/2024-nas-election.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240430193331/https://www.nasonline.org/news-and-multimedia/news/2024-nas-election.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=April 30, 2024 |access-date=12 May 2024 |website=www.nasonline.org}}</ref>
